title: Guest Chat acceptance mistakes a delegated-tool handoff for a completed answer
reproduction: Run the receipt-bound guest Chat test against the public demo page with its unpredictable page codes.
Observe the panel after the page-text tool suspends the first stream and before the resumed assistant answers.
The old predicate accepts replyCount greater than its initial value with no Stop button even though the visible text is only Reasoning and Finding text.
expected: The runner observes a real terminal stream state and tests the answer-producing assistant text for the page-only code and workflow stages. A terminal wrong or empty answer fails; a delegated-tool pause remains in progress.
actual: On exact candidate 0.2.173 the runner stopped at two Copy reply matches and no Stop button. Its captured screenshot and text contained no required answer. The guest product outcome remains unverified by that run.
severity: S3: false native acceptance failure leaves guest completion inconclusive
priority: P1: exact candidate acceptance is held on this result
root_cause: ChatView finalizes an assistant bubble and renders Copy reply when a client-delegated tool ends its stream. WIRE_CONTRACT section 5 requires a later tool_results and resume stream for the final answer. The runner treated a finalized bubble and idle Stop button as terminal turn completion.
sibling_census: The same original predicate guarded both opening and post-reload guest answers in this runner; both now use the same terminal oracle. Other native Chat runners require separate review before reusing this test helper.
verification_status: Source and captured UI prove the old predicate's false terminal. Initial focused oracle tests passed 5/5. Independent review found two important collector/classifier gaps; round-one source repair now records failed user-request completions and treats uncoded 409 as pending. Added collector-seam tests have syntax checks but await guarded test admission. Fresh independent review and native rerun are pending; no product-side guest Chat defect is claimed from the old run.

transition_history.reason: Candidate 0.2.173 stopped on a tool-only-looking intermediate panel state.
